prompt: Make a new pixel-art piece at maximum quality: "Samurai Duel in the Rain". A real-time three.js scene rendered small and quantised to a palette: a mountain shrine on a floating island at night in heavy rain (hall with vermilion pillars, torii gate, stone lanterns, koi pond, cedar, maple, bamboo). Six original swordsmen meet two at a time: arrival in straw hats, seconds with umbrellas, the drum, the bow, the draw; stances, cuts, parries, locked blades, and a final charge past each other in a lightning flash. Nobody dies — the loser is disarmed or has the hair cord cut, kneels and bows; the winner shakes off the rain and sheathes the blade. Rain that splashes, ripples puddles and drips from eaves, wet reflections, lightning, synthesized sound, dusk/night, close-up camera. English UI.
